name: Neurosity Crown EEG Visualizer
description: Plan and implement a Neurosity Crown EEG particle visualizer based on the spec in gptSpec.txt
initialInput:
Build a Neurosity Crown EEG visualizer application.

The full technical specification is at /home/erik/Documents/eegVis/gptSpec.txt — read it first.

The target directory is /home/erik/Documents/eegVis/. There is NO existing project scaffolding — you need to create everything from scratch.

Key points from the spec:
- Process A (Node.js): Connect to Crown via @neurosity/sdk, subscribe to brainwaves, forward over UDP
- Process B (C++/CUDA/OpenGL): Receive UDP → ring buffer → GPU preprocessing + features → particle sim → render
- Crown raw is 256 Hz, 8 EEG channels, 16 samples per epoch
- Neurofeedback loop: alpha → coherence/viscosity, beta → turbulence/emission
- Calibration phase (baseline calm + baseline active)

The planning stage should produce a detailed implementation directive covering project structure, build system, dependencies, and file-by-file implementation plan.

The coding stage should implement everything and verify it compiles.

councilSetup.name: Planning Council

personas.name: GPU/Graphics Expert
personas.domain: CUDA, OpenGL, GPU computing, real-time graphics

councilSetup.expectedOutput: A detailed implementation directive covering: CMake project structure, all source files with descriptions, CUDA kernel designs, OpenGL rendering pipeline, Node.js ingest script, build instructions, and dependency list.

councilSetup.name: Coding Council
councilSetup.expectedOutput: Working implementation of the Neurosity Crown EEG particle visualizer with all source files, CMakeLists.txt, and Node.js ingest script.
